## Install

1. Download the `.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Move **Mara AI** to your **Applications** folder and open it.
3. macOS says it can't verify the developer: Mara is signed but not notarized, since the project
   has no paid Apple Developer account. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down
   and click **Open Anyway** next to Mara AI. You only do this once.
4. Allow **Screen & System Audio Recording** when macOS asks, then quit and reopen Mara.

Requires macOS 26 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon. To check the download:
`shasum -a 256 -c Mara-AI-*.zip.sha256`. Prefer to build it yourself? See
[Getting started](https://github.com/guilhermekollet/mara-ai#getting-started).
